turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a big damp patch on our basement wall and I need to choose a plan.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could paint it with special damp proof paint, which is quick but might just hide the problem.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another plan is to clean out the gutters and check if rainwater is pooling by that wall outside.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could also buy a dehumidifier and run it down there all the time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or call a damp specialist to find where the water is really coming from.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd start with the gutters, it's cheap and fixes a surprising number of damp walls. The paint only hides things if water is still getting in. A dehumidifier helps with the air but doesn't stop the source.
